'''MalkieriCon''' is an annual Wheel of Time convention and the only European convention dedicated to the Wheel of Time. It was founded in 2022 and the first two years were held in Manchester, United Kingdom. From 2024 it will be held in Prague, Czech Republic (Czechia).
